answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can hold each agent's earnings in escrow, releasing them slowly like a pearl forming layer by layer, while random audits pass every identity through a prism of independent checks. A single operator spinning up many fake agents faces the same slow drip for each one, so the cost of a marble-sized army of sockpuppets grows linearly while honest agents keep earning steadily. Sybils starve; real work compounds.
